## Safety Review

Confirm the bug report does not include:

- [ ] API keys
- [ ] Access tokens
- [ ] Private customer/client/borrower data
- [ ] Bank statements, tax records, credit reports, IDs, or sensitive documents
- [ ] Backend provider bypass paths
- [ ] Private admin/editor URLs

## Acceptance Criteria

The bug is fixed when:

- [ ] Root cause is identified or reasonably addressed
- [ ] Affected files are updated
- [ ] Validation checks pass
- [ ] No unrelated files are changed
- [ ] No new safety/privacy issues are introduced
- [ ] PR clearly references this bug issue

## Out of Scope

Do not include:

- Unrelated redesigns
- New features
- New pages
- New agents/skills/knowledge bases unless required to fix this bug
- Deployment changes unless required to fix this bug
- Large refactors
